thread:
Ravi (PM): Heads-up: drafting the Private Deploy beta gates. Need quick alignment on scope: install presets, upgrade guarantees, and comms.
Keiko (Eng): Suggest we call presets `lite` (NAT-first), `preserve` (static-egress), and `relay-lite` (experimental). Keep relay out of beta.
Diego (Field SE): Field input: customers want an install that doesn't require inbound firewall rules and a clear IP-preserve migration path. Example: confirm SNAT pools won't change during operator upgrade.
Ravi (PM): Good. Beta candidate gates: presets `lite` + `preserve`; automated upgrade with IP-preserve toggle; rollback script; netops handoff doc; and canary gating.
Sami (Customer Success): Pilot ask from DataBank: cert continuity and <5m disruption for operator upgrades. They also want a rollback checklist they can hand to their SOC.
Keiko (Eng): Implementation idea: operator runs dual dataplanes during upgrade when `preserve=true`. New dataplane registers, validates source ip mapping, then flips. Pros: near-zero traffic interruption. Cons: more memory/state.
Iris (Release): Canary plan: 5% installs, 45m burn. Metrics: handshake failures, auth error rate, control RTT. Abort thresholds: auth>0.5% or handshake errs spike >0.3%. Can deploy-bot enforce?
deploy-bot: Canary job template available: `tools/canary_gate --pct=5 --dur=45m --auth=0.5 --handshake=0.3`. Exits non-zero on failure.
Diego (Field SE): Docs: add NetOps checklist (verify egress IP, sample iptables fix for old kernels, terraform snippet for reserving static egress). Also include simple SNI validation steps.
Ravi (PM): Action items: Keiko: design doc + `preserve` flag spec by Tue EOD. Diego: NetOps handoff + terraform snippet by Wed. Iris: canary job + image tags by Thu. Sami: pilot comms + rollback playbook by Thu EOD.
Keiko (Eng): Estimate: preserve flag + dual-dataplane ~2 sprints; canary integration 1 sprint; docs 1 sprint. Can parallelize across 3 engineers.
Sami (Customer Success): I'll line up two pilot customers (DataBank, FinSecure) pending docs. Need a short SLA impact note.
Ravi (PM): Noted. We'll default to alpha if any gate missing. Follow-up in next product huddle. Keep replies short. :white_check_mark:
